target_customer: Public safety agencies, cities, law enforcement and organizations that operate many video cameras
problem: Public safety teams run many separate camera systems and cannot search them quickly. EdgeTrace unifies camera feeds in an AI video management system searchable with natural language, images and audio.
business_model: B2B and government SaaS for video management and search, pricing not found
product_category: AI video management and video search for public safety

founders.name: Kyle Orciuch
founders.role: Founder/President (YC page), listed as CEO by one directory

founders.role: Founder (listed on the YC page as a former founder)
founders.background_notes: Background not on the YC page.

competitors.name: Lumana
competitors.what: AI powered video surveillance system launched with natural language style video search

technical_complexity.rationale: Multimodal search across many live camera networks needs vision-language models, video ingestion at scale and integration with varied camera hardware.

defensibility.rationale: Government buyers face procurement hurdles that can lock in vendors, but semantic video search was being built by many vendors and the models are not proprietary.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Several surveillance vendors added natural language video search in 2024 to 2026; no acquisition of EdgeTrace was found.

market_need_then: Public safety agencies hold large volumes of camera footage that is slow to search manually, and generative AI made natural language video search feasible around 2023 and 2024.

branding.domain_note: Uses edgetrace.ai, an .ai domain; the page could not be fetched for review.

identity.voice_and_tone: action oriented tagline: Describe It. Find It. Act On It.

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: Describe It. Find It. Act On It.

brand_strength.rationale: Directory listings exist and the tagline is clear, but no press or community about the brand was found, and similar names like EdgeTrack and Edge Delta exist.

outcome_analysis: EdgeTrace is an active, very small YC Winter 2024 company selling AI video search to public safety teams. Aggregators report roughly 500K USD of early funding, but there is no verified later round, customer list or exit, so the outcome is unclear. It faces vendors such as Lumana and March Networks that ship similar natural language search.
